---
name: Feature task
about: Small, testable work item for feature/* -> dev
---

## Goal

What must become true?

## Scope

- [ ] Smallest implementation unit identified.
- [ ] Out-of-scope items listed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deterministic behavior defined.
- [ ] Tests or verification commands defined.
- [ ] Self-inspection impact considered.
- [ ] Documentation/generated-state impact considered.

## Branch

Create `feature/<issue-number>-<short-slug>` from `dev`, then open a PR back to `dev` with `Refs #<issue-number>`.
